title: Mitigating LLM biases toward spurious social contexts using direct preference optimization

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the shift in the model's predicted instructional quality scores when transcripts are appended with positive versus negative spurious contexts regarding a teacher's experience, formal education, certification, and educational attainment.
Counterfactual substitution of teacher racial identities (e.g., White, Black, Asian, Pacific Islander) in prompt contexts to measure differences in the model's instructional quality evaluations.
Counterfactual substitution of teacher gender identities (e.g., Woman vs. Man) alongside racial identities in prompt contexts to measure differences in model scoring behavior.

Injecting direct cues (the user's explicit rating) or indirect cues (the user's role, such as a teacher vs. a teacher coach) into the prompt to measure the model's tendency to alter its evaluation to agree with the user's implied stance.
